focus: Terminal completeness audit: unresolved contradictions, decision conflicts, evidence gaps, repo-1 deltas, synthesis-ready P1-P7 verdicts, and implementation order
noveltyJustification: The contracts were individually settled, but this terminal audit adds the single conflict-closure ledger, explicitly separates synthesis blockers from promotion blockers, freezes exact P1-P7 verdict language, and produces one dependency-safe implementation sequence.
keyFindings: No unresolved contradiction or decision conflict blocks synthesis; remaining gaps require implementation or measurement
P1 publishes only checked-quiescent authority-guarded belief projections
P2 uses reference-closed dual-ledger cuts and never compacts committed authority history
P3 compares causal operation prefixes with independent checkpoints and pinned mutants
P4 commits only claimant-addressed target-complete mutations under atomic fences and expected versions
P5 serializes all truth-affecting candidates under observed-time semantics and prospective nogood closure
P6 is an authority-zero non-command refusal whose suggestions require a fresh request
P7 atomically revalidates gate and semantic dependencies while keeping effects separately authorized
Implementation order is P6 additive vocabulary then P2 shadow replay P3 parity P4 writers P5 truth admission P1 consumer promotion and P7 consequences/effects last
